Body.Content:
Supports returning unused retainer balances through the project invoice rather than correcting previously confirmed invoices solely to release the remaining amount. Billing teams can choose whether to retain or refund the balance, simplifying project closeout even when there are no new chargeable transactions.

GA date: February CY2027
